query:
SELECT room_id, event_type, user_id, content, stream_id, created_ts
            FROM (
                SELECT
                    room_id,
                    event_type,
                    user_id,
                    content,
                    stream_id,
                    created_ts,
                    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                        PARTITION BY room_id
                        ORDER BY stream_id DESC
                    ) AS rn
                FROM room_ephemeral
                WHERE room_id = ANY($1)
                  AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > $2)
            ) ranked
            WHERE rn <= $3
            ORDER BY room_id, stream_id DESC
